description: The Balzers filter set at Apache Point Observatory consists of twelve neutral density filters (ND1 through ND12) providing attenuation across optical wavelengths for instruments on the ARC 3.5-meter telescope.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical and infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in the Sacramento Mountains of New Mexico, owned and operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: Balzers neutral density filters (50x50x2 mm) in the APO 3.5m instrument pool. Numerical transmission curves are provided by the APO filter database without an open redistribution grant.
